messages:
sara_l: FYI PR #49102 is ready for merge — it touches eviction + prefetch config and changes the routing fallback. link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/49102

sara_l: plan is to canary tomorrow 10:00 PT for 30m, then promote if no regressions. need runtime + security owners to ack and a merge slot.

michael_t: sending to runtime owners — @jamie_runtime can you take primary on canary ownership?

jamie_runtime: I can own the canary. quick skim: looks like allocator threshold tweak + metric names. will run local smoke and tail kv logs during canary. :+1:

priya_r: tagging security for the authz header ordering change — @alex_security can you confirm no additional review needed?

alex_security: will review this afternoon. initial glance: no new data exfil paths but I want to confirm header canonicalization in the platform client change. I can sign off by 1700 PT if nothing surprising.

deploy-bot: CI checks: unit tests ✅, integration smoke ✅, canary job scheduled (slot request pending).

michael_t: if security signs off by 1700 we can request a merge slot for 09:30 tomorrow and start canary at 10:00. who can be on-call for rollback?

jamie_runtime: I will be on-call for the canary window and will coordinate rollback if we see latency spike or tail errors. I also set up an alert on eviction-rate > 2x baseline.

priya_r: thanks — I'll prepare the rollback playbook snippet and prod runbook update and drop it in the PR description.

sara_l: awesome. @alex_security please ping here when you're done. if we have signoff by EOD we lock the 09:30 merge slot.

alex_security: SG, will update here once review done. if I find anything blocking I'll call it out, otherwise :white_check_mark:

jamie_runtime: one note — can we enable verbose eviction logs for the 30m canary only? adds ~1% CPU but helps triage. who can flip the flag?

michael_t: I can add a temporary flag in the deployment manifest and revert after. I'll put that change behind the same PR if everyone agrees.

sara_l: agree — include it in the PR with a comment that it's a temporary canary flag. ok locking folks: runtime owner = jamie_runtime, security = alex_security, fallback ops = michael_t. thanks all.
